note: Open issuer tender offers (SC TO-I filed in the last 60 days, not yet expired) whose Offer to Purchase has an odd-lot priority clause. Information only: no order is ever placed. Profit = 99 x minimum price - 99 x last close x 1.008 - 3 USD commission - 25 USD corporate-action fee (both ASSUMED). Ask ZAD before acting.

offers.name: INVE Technologies, Inc.
offers.oddLotQuote: For purposes of the Offer, the term "odd lots" means all shares properly tendered at prices at or below the Final Purchase Price held by a stockholder who owns beneficially or of record an aggregate of fewer than 100 shares, which we refer to as an "odd lot holder."

offers.name: UTAH MEDICAL PRODUCTS INC
offers.oddLotQuote: Proration is calculating your proportion of the total shares tendered when the total is greater than the number of shares that UTMD actually purchases. 3 First, we subtract the number of odd lot shares from the total shares tendered.
